d.title: Dragon Ball Movie 4: Saikyou e no Michi
d.en: Dragon Ball: The Path to Power
d.jp: ドラゴンボール 最強への道
d.synopsis: A retelling of Dragon Ball's origin with a different take on the meeting of Goku, Bulma, and Kame-Sen'nin. It also retells the Red Ribbon Army story; but this time they find Goku rather than Goku finding them.
